equation_request.abstract: We present improved circuits for the control-control-phase (Toffoli) gate and the control-swap (Fredkin) gate using three and four global two-qubit gates, respectively. This is a nearly double speed-up compared to the conventional circuits, which require five (for Toffoli) and seven (for Fredkin) conditional two-qubit gates. We apply the same approach to construct the conditional four-qubit phase gate by seven global two-qubit gates. We also present construction of the Toffoli and the Fredkin gates with five nearest-neighbour interactions. Our constructions do not employ ancilla qubits or ancilla internal states and are particularly well suited for ion qubits and for circuit QED systems, where the entangling operations can be implemented by global addressing.

specification.problem: Implement the CCZ (control-control-phase/Toffoli-equivalent) and Fredkin (controlled-SWAP) gates on qubits using few global two-qubit gates, without ancillas. The abstract gives only gate counts, not the explicit gate sequences.
specification.reconstruction_scope: Define the target unitaries (CCZ, Toffoli via Hadamard conjugation, Fredkin) and the conventional conditional-two-qubit-gate decomposition of CCZ as background, plus the abstract's gate-count claims. The paper's global-gate circuits, the four-qubit phase gate with seven gates, and the nearest-neighbour constructions are outside scope and not reconstructed.
